datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2011 across Burkina Faso administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases and scenarios, spatially distributed as geographic features with collection dates and scenario parameters to support food security monitoring.
